reading: SIMULATION §4 read literally: protocols lacking a valid L8 Calibration Bundle are NON-ENFORCEABLE. This concerns the enforceability of their outputs. It does not remove physical records or written constraints, nor the right to check them in an isolated research model; every lab run is research (operational_use: false), and no lab parameter is a calibration.
